BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   C. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

9. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

13. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.

15. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
